@@ -243,5 +243,111 @@
-        # save class variables
-        self.merges = merges # used in encode()

-
-    def register_special_tokens
+        # save class variables
+        self.merges = merges # used in encode()
+        self.vocab = vocab   # used in decode()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _train_str(ids, weights, stats, heap, num_merges, sep, verbose):
+        # Same merges as the list-based loop in train(), with every token id
+        # kept as the code point chr(id): the chunks of equal weight are joined
+        # by sep (above every token id, so no pair crosses a chunk boundary)
+        # and pair occurrences are found and replaced in C. doc holds all the
+        # chunks in order, so doc.find gives the earliest occurrence for ties.
+        groups = {}
+        strs = []
+        for chunk_ids, w in zip(ids, weights):
+            t = bytes(chunk_ids).decode("latin-1")
+            strs.append(t)
+            groups.setdefault(w, []).append(t)
+        doc = sep.join(strs)
+        groups = [(sep.join(g), w) for w, g in groups.items()]
+        stats_get = stats.get
+        merges = {}
+        vocab = {idx: bytes([idx]) for idx in range(256)}
+        for i in range(num_merges):
+            while heap:
+                c, pair = heap[0]
+                if stats_get(pair) == -c:
+                    break
+                heappop(heap)
+            else:
+                max(stats.values()) # empty stats: same error as before
+            top = -c
+            heappop(heap)
+            tied = None
+            while heap and heap[0][0] == c:
+                q = heappop(heap)[1]
+                if stats_get(q) == top:
+                    if tied is None:
+                        tied = {pair}
+                    tied.add(q)
+            if tied is not None and len(tied) > 1:
+                best = -1
+                for q in tied:
+                    heappush(heap, (c, q))
+                    j = doc.find(chr(q[0]) + chr(q[1]))
+                    if best < 0 or j < best:
+                        best = j
+                        pair = q
+            idx = 256 + i
+            p0, p1 = pair
+            ps = chr(p0) + chr(p1)
+            ci = chr(idx)
+            touched = [pair]
+            rapp = touched.append
+            total = 0
+            for gi in range(len(groups)):
+                s, w = groups[gi]
+                find = s.find
+                j = find(ps)
+                if j < 0:
+                    continue
+                # occurrences merged by merge(): left to right, non-overlapping
+                pos = []
+                pos_app = pos.append
+                while j >= 0:
+                    pos_app(j)
+                    j = find(ps, j + 2)
+                n = len(s)
+                k = len(pos)
+                total += k * w
+                prev_end = -1
+                for m in range(k):
+                    j = pos[m]
+                    if j and j != prev_end:
+                        a = s[j-1]
+                        if a != sep:
+                            a = ord(a)
+                            p = (a, p0)
+                            stats[p] -= w
+                            rapp(p)
+                            p = (a, idx)
+                            stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
+                            rapp(p)
+                    if j + 2 < n:
+                        b = s[j+2]
+                        if b != sep:
+                            b = ord(b)
+                            p = (p1, b)
+                            stats[p] -= w
+                            rapp(p)
+                            if m + 1 < k and pos[m+1] == j + 2:
+                                b = idx
+                            p = (idx, b)
+                            stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
+                            rapp(p)
+                    prev_end = j + 2
+                groups[gi] = (s.replace(ps, ci), w)
+            stats[pair] -= total
+            doc = doc.replace(ps, ci)
+            for p in set(touched):
+                c = stats_get(p)
+                if c:
+                    heappush(heap, (-c, p))
+                elif c == 0:
+                    del stats[p]
+            merges[pair] = idx
+            vocab[idx] = vocab[p0] + vocab[p1]
+            if verbose:
+                print(f"merge {i+1}/{num_merges}: {pair} -> {idx} ({vocab[idx]}) had {top} occurrences")
+        return merges, vocab
+
+    def register_special_tokens
